hero.headline: Join Us Wherever You Are
hero.subheadline: Experience the presence of God from anywhere in the world. Our services stream live every Sunday and Wednesday — all are welcome.

stream.headline: Sunday Service — Live Now
stream.offline_body: Our next live service begins Sunday at 8:00 AM CST. Set a reminder and join us as we worship together.
stream.youtube_note: Services stream live on YouTube. Click below to watch on our channel.

items.label: Morning Worship Service
items.description: Start your Sunday in the presence of God — praise, prayer, and the Word.

items.label: Family Worship Service
items.description: Our main gathering — vibrant worship, biblical teaching, and community.

items.label: Midweek Bible Study
items.description: Deepen your understanding of Scripture in our midweek teaching service.

items.title: Watch on YouTube
items.description: Subscribe to our YouTube channel and turn on notifications so you never miss a service. No account required to watch.

items.title: Join the Live Chat
items.description: Participate in real-time during the service. Share prayer requests, greet fellow worshippers, and engage with the message.

items.title: Watch on Demand
items.description: Missed a service? All past messages are available on our channel to watch at any time, at your own pace.

prayer.headline: Online Doesn't Mean Alone
prayer.body: Distance is no barrier to community. Whether you're watching from across town or across the world, you are part of this family. Submit a prayer request, give, or reach out — we'd love to hear from you.
